nurse.text: Hello, my lovely! Welcome to the Cotswolds Sanctuary. Mind the step; it's been here since the wool trade and it has opinions.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop your team on the counter. There's tea, and honey from the hives out the back, which has the same colour as the walls and the same sort of sweetness.
There we are. Right as rain, and the rain is mostly lovely too.
The Ark is in the corner. A lovely bit of oak, from a barn that blew down in the last gale.

else.text: No hurry. Have a look at the walls; there's no wall in this village that hasn't been photographed.
